summary.text: Simran Arora is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 80, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Mike Bare. She was also a candidate for Dane County Board of Supervisors District 9 in the April 7, 2026 election.

paragraphs.text: Simran Arora ran for the Dane County Board of Supervisors, District 9, and lost in the general election on April 7, 2026.
She advanced from the Republican primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 80 on August 11, 2026.
